reason: H0 exclusively compiles WUFFS_CONFIG__MODULE__JSON and calls wuffs_json__decoder__decode_tokens; it never compiles or invokes the new std/png decoder. Consequently, S1's PNG byte parsing and stateful base.image_decoder API are wholly unfuzzed, including implicit decode transitions, restart behavior, nullable destinations, and attacker-controlled dimensions and chunk lengths.
evidence: H0 defines WUFFS_CONFIG__MODULE__JSON but not a PNG module and instantiates only wuffs_json__decoder.
decoder.decode_image_config reads the PNG signature, IHDR fields, width, height, depth, color type, compression, filter, interlace, and a sequence of chunk_length/chunk_type values until IDAT.
decoder.decode_frame_config and decoder.decode_frame implement call_sequence transitions across 0x00, 0x03, 0x04, and 0xFF, including implicit calls with dst: nullptr.
decoder.restart_frame accepts index and io_position and mutates call_sequence and frame_config_io_position, creating a distinct restart protocol not exercised by H0.
decode_image_config derives bytes_per_row and workbuf_length from input-controlled width, height, depth, and color type, while workbuf_len exposes the resulting allocation requirement.
recommended_action: Add a dedicated PNG image-decoder fuzz harness that compiles the PNG module and feeds arbitrary, incrementally limited input through decode_image_config, decode_frame_config, and decode_frame. Exercise direct and implicit call sequences, nullable and non-null destinations, repeated/end-of-data calls, restart_frame with varied index/io_position values, malformed or truncated chunks and lengths, dimension/color/depth combinations, and work buffers around workbuf_len boundaries.
